title: TOWARDS MEASURING AND SCORING SPEAKER DIARIZATION FAIRNESS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measured speaker diarization fairness based on gender, age, accent, and spoken sentence length.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion. Its focus is on fairness in speaker diarization across gender, age, accent, and sentence length.
